prepareInstallation.description: The information required for the installation.

components.name: votingMode
components.description: A parameter to select the vote mode. In standard mode (0), early execution and vote replacement are disabled. In early execution mode (1), a proposal can be executed early before the end date if the vote outcome cannot mathematically change by more voters voting. In vote replacement mode (2), voters can change their vote multiple times and only the latest vote option is tallied.

components.name: supportThreshold
components.description: The support threshold value. Its value has to be in the interval [0, 10^6] defined by `RATIO_BASE = 10**6`.

components.name: minParticipation
components.description: The minimum participation value. Its value has to be in the interval [0, 10^6] defined by `RATIO_BASE = 10**6`.

components.name: minDuration
components.description: The minimum duration of the proposal vote in seconds.

components.name: minProposerVotingPower
components.description: The minimum voting power required to create a proposal.

inputs.name: votingSettings
inputs.description: The voting settings that will be enforced when proposals are created.

components.name: token
components.description: The token address. If this is `address(0)`, a new `GovernanceERC20` token is deployed. If not, the existing token is wrapped as an `GovernanceWrappedERC20`.

components.name: name
components.description: The token name. This parameter is only relevant if the token address is `address(0)`.

components.name: symbol
components.description: The token symbol. This parameter is only relevant if the token address is `address(0)`.

inputs.name: tokenSettings
inputs.description: The token settings that either specify an existing ERC-20 token (`token = address(0)`) or the name and symbol of a new `GovernanceERC20` token to be created.

components.name: amounts
components.description: The amounts of tokens to be minted for each receiver.

inputs.name: mintSettings
inputs.description: The token mint settings struct containing the `receivers` and `amounts`.

components.name: target
components.description: The target contract to which actions will be forwarded to for execution.

components.name: operation
components.description: The operation type(either `call` or `delegatecall`) that will be used for execution forwarding.

inputs.name: minApproval
inputs.description: The minimum amount of yes votes needed for the proposal advance.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.description: The metadata that contains the information about the token voting plugin.

inputs.name: excludedAccounts
inputs.description: The accounts to exclude from the token supply computation.

components.name: proposerHatId
components.description: The ID of the hat that is required to create proposals.

components.name: voterHatId
components.description: The ID of the hat that is required to vote on proposals.

components.name: executorHatId
components.description: The ID of the hat that is required to execute proposals.

prepareUninstallation.description: No input is required for the uninstallation.
